name: Sodium
reactivity_note: Reacts violently with water, releasing hydrogen gas and heat.

name: Magnesium
reactivity_note: Burns brightly in oxygen and reacts slowly with cold water.

name: Calcium
reactivity_note: Reacts steadily with water, producing hydrogen gas and bubbling.

name: Iron
reactivity_note: Rusts slowly in moist air and reacts with dilute acids.

name: Copper
reactivity_note: Unreactive with water or dilute acids; slowly forms a green patina in air.

name: Zinc
reactivity_note: Reacts readily with dilute acids, releasing hydrogen gas.

name: Potassium
reactivity_note: Reacts explosively with water, more vigorously than sodium.

name: Aluminum
reactivity_note: Forms a protective oxide layer but reacts with both acids and bases.

name: Carbon
reactivity_note: Burns in oxygen to form carbon dioxide.

name: Sulfur
reactivity_note: Burns in oxygen with a blue flame, forming sulfur dioxide.

name: Hydrogen
reactivity_note: Highly flammable; reacts explosively with oxygen to form water.

name: Oxygen
reactivity_note: Supports combustion; reacts with most metals to form oxides.

name: Nitrogen
reactivity_note: Largely inert at room temperature; requires high energy to react.

name: Chlorine
reactivity_note: Highly reactive; combines readily with metals and hydrogen.

name: Lithium
reactivity_note: Reacts with water more gently than sodium, releasing hydrogen gas.

name: Silver
reactivity_note: Largely unreactive; tarnishes slowly on contact with sulfur compounds.

name: Lead
reactivity_note: Reacts very slowly with dilute acids; resists corrosion.

name: Tin
reactivity_note: Reacts slowly with dilute acids; does not react with water.

name: Nickel
reactivity_note: Corrosion-resistant; reacts slowly with dilute acids.

name: Manganese
reactivity_note: Reacts with dilute acids, releasing hydrogen gas.
